pages.title: Light in Glass
pages.text: Stray aether settles into glass, lending it resilience and a faint glow. The glass survives being broken.$(br2)It can enclose more aether, but cannot hold it through a move: $(l)breaking a tank releases what was inside.$()

pages.title: An Ordered Lattice
pages.text: Diamond and emerald lattices hold aether more steadily than glass. Their small size limits their capacity, but makes them suited to portable containers and the hearts of wands and emitters.
